description: Capability for the SOMS main window. The app-defined commands (get_api_origin, set_session_token, clear_session_token) are registered in invoke_handler and reachable from the webview; core IPC is enabled via core:default; notification:default lets UnreadAttentionService post desktop system notifications via tauri-plugin-notification. http:default + a wide URL scope let the webview's native-fetch override (installNativeFetch, web/.../runtime.ts) reach ANY user-configured backend through tauri-plugin-http, bypassing the webview's CORS gate (a bundled app's https://tauri.localhost origin is cross-origin to every real backend).
